sections.title: General
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Site Hazard Identification Board displayed, with review date?
Is there a notice board for minutes, policies etc.?
Is the H&S Policy displayed?
Has a Job Analysis been completed for all task?

sections.title: Site Amenities
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is the toilet facility in a clean and sanitary condition?
Is the lunchroom clean and tidy?
Are the shower and washroom clean and tidy?
Is the locker room clean and tidy?
Is rubbish cleared?
Is there an adequate supply of clean, fresh drinking water?
Are the amenities in good repair?

sections.title: Emergency Response Preparedness
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are sufficient fire extinguishers provided?
Have all extinguishers been tested in the last 12 months?
Are signs indicating specific use of fire extinguishers in place?
Have site personnel been trained in the use of extinguishers?
Are combustible materials properly stored/disposed of?
Is there easy access to firefighting equipment?
Do emergency service vehicles have clear access to the site?
Have evacuation drills been carried out in the last six months?
Is there a functioning alarm system for emergencies?

sections.title: First Aid
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is there an adequate number of first aid kits?
Are they adequately stocked?
Is there a list of qualified first aiders attached to each kit?
Are the kits visible/accessible?
Are emergency eyewash/shower facilities clean and serviceable?
Are first aiders identified by safety vests or singage?

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is the work area in a clean and tidy state?
Is there adequate, appropriate and clear signage?
Are all storage areas tidy?
Is the work area free from slipping/tripping hazards?

sections.title: Access and Egress
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is there safe access around the work area?
Is lighting adequate for safe access?
Are access ways in storage areas/containers free of obstructions?

sections.title: Ladders
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are all ladders stable and securely fixed at the top and bottom?
Are all rungs and styles intact and in good condition?
Is the slope of the ladder at a safe angle 4:1?
Are the ladders clear of doorways?
Do the ladders extend at least 1m above landing places?
Are only fibreglass or timber ladders used near electricity?
Are ladders protected from moving vehicles?
Are 3 and 4 step ladders present on site?

sections.title: Electrical
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are portable electrical equipment/leads tested & tagged?
Are they currently in date for test & tag?
Are RCDs used with all portable electrical equipment?
Are leads and cables in good condition?
Is electrical equipment properly stored when not in use?
Are extension leads supported above work and damp areas?
Do leads have clear plugs fitted and not hard plastic?

sections.title: Compressed Gasses
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are bottles stored upright and secured?
Are bottles free from grease and oil?
Are cylinders turned off at the bottle and not the regulator?
Are storage and transport adequate?
Are all cylinders fitted with flashback arresters?
Are gas cutting equipment hoses in good condition?
Are compressed air hoses secured with pins/chains?

sections.title: Plant, Equipment and Vehicles
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are all plant/trucks fitted with functioning reversing alarms?
Is all plant, equipment & vehicles maintained on a recorded schedule?
Do only qualified/licensed personnel operate the plant/equipment?
Are extinguishers installed and operable?
Is the plant working too close to overhead power lines?
Does all plant have the Safe Working Load (SWL) displayed?
Is plant in confined spaces fitted with exhaust emission devices?
Does each item of the plant have a correctly filled out logbook?
Are Personal Danger Tags correctly completed and in place?
Are Out of Service Tags correctly completed and in place?
Are barricades / barrier tape in use
Are isolations/lockouts in use?

sections.title: Personal Protective Equipment
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is eye protection worn when necessary?
Are hard hats worn when necessary?
Is foot protection adequate?
Is SPF15+ sunscreen provided for personnel exposed to the sun?
Are appropriate gloves provided to protect hands?
Is hearing protection worn when necessary?
Is respiratory protection worn when necessary?
Are all personal on-site wearing the correct PPE

sections.title: Dangerous Good and Hazardous Substances
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Is there a register of DGs & Haz. Subs?
Is there a store for DGs & Haz. Subs?
Are Material Safety Data Sheets available for all goods in this store?
Is there adequate signage around this store?
Are all containers clearly labelled?
Is ventilation equipment operating effectively?
Is the amount stored by statutory limits?
Is waste material stored/disposed of safely?

sections.title: Scaffolding
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are there solid foundations under the scaffolding?
Are there proper sole and base plates for the standards?
Is there adequate bracing in all directions?
Are handrails and toe boards in place on all over 2m scaffolds?
Are all work platforms fully decked out?
Is there safe access to the work platforms?
Is scaffolding tied to the structure at least every 3.6m in height?
Do mobile scaffolds have both hand and mid rails?
Do mobile scaffolds have lockable castor wheels?
Are all wheels locked when the scaffold is in use?
Is there safe ladder access to the mobile scaffold?
Are scaffolds inspected regularly by a competent/qualified person?

sections.title: Welding and Grinding
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are protective screens used during welding operations?
Are welder/grinder/cutter operators using appropriate PPE?
Are surrounding personnel protected against welding/grinding operations?

sections.title: Manual Handling
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Have all personnel been trained in manual handling techniques?
Are correct manual handling techniques being followed?
Is mechanical equipment available for lifting heavy loads?

sections.title: Environmental Work Practices
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are there any leaks or spills causing land or water pollution?
Is waste being stored and disposed of appropriately?
Is plant, equipment or vehicles emitting noise or air pollution?
Is there sufficient containment for drums, tanks and other containers?
Are there spill kits available for use?
Is there soil erosion, vegetation damage or other environmental harm?

sections.title: Quality Assurance
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Have ITPs been captured?
Have ITPs been closed?

sections.title: Defects
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: BLACK defects captured?
Client defects received?
All defects closed out?

sections.title: Contractors Management
sections.purpose: Record the inspector's answer to each item from the recording.
items: Are Sub-contractors pre-qualified? (completed sub-contractor H&S questionnaire)
Has pre-start sub-contractor audit been completed?
Has a senior BLACK representative conducted a sub-contractor audit?

catch_all.title: Anything else
catch_all.purpose: Only what will still matter next week and fits nowhere above. One sentence each. If there is nothing, write "Nothing here."
